resources.string: Lets chosen people or devices manage TailSocks on other devices: you only choose who manages whom. Writes one rule for TCP port 28115 and a test that keeps it.

Opens only TailSocks\'s remote-management port, TCP 28115, from the managers\' devices to the managed ones. Whether a manager is the owner or a guest is decided by the managed device, by account — not by this rule.
Users, groups or tags whose devices manage the others; every member, for a rule where each person manages their own devices.
Users, groups or tags whose devices are managed. \"Their own devices\" lets each person manage only what they own.
\"Their own devices\" works only for people: users, groups or every member. Take %1$s out of \"Who manages\", or \"Their own devices\" out of \"Whose devices\".
The policy already lets these devices reach port 28115, so no new rule is needed. Open a rule below to see it.
No test: a test names only users, groups and tags that have devices — not \"their own devices\" or every member.
Create the rule and the test
Choose who manages and whose devices.
